Hi Olivia — thanks for the details and the screenshot. Investigated from the onboarding side:

Summary of findings (from logs):
- Invite token issued at 2028-02-10T09:09:15-08:00; portal set OTP TTL = 120s by default for GreenForge tenant.
- We see three validate attempts from your IP (masked) at 09:09:40, 09:10:12, 09:10:50 that returned "invalid or expired code".
- The gateway between Redwood and our SMS/email provider showed delivery latency spikes (up to ~30s) during the 09:09–09:11 window.
- One additional anomaly: some clients that auto-convert line endings (mobile push clients, certain mail clients) were trimming trailing characters when copying. The screenshot shows the code with a trailing period in the email body; if the user copies it including punctuation the paste will fail.

Short-term fixes I can push now:
1) Reissue a fresh invite and temporarily set OTP TTL to 300s for the next 30 minutes while we monitor.
2) Turn on "magic link" option for your tenant so the user can click-through authentication instead of typing OTP. This requires a quick tenant-level preference flip and a short security check — acceptable to do if you approve.

Longer-term actions for us:
- Work with delivery provider to remove the observed latency spikes (ticket opened).
- Strip punctuation around codes in email template and add clearer copy: "Paste only the 6-digit code".

Would you like me to reissue now and enable the magic link trial? If yes I'll send a new invite and PM you the DocuSign/one-click verification flow so you can accept quickly.

Rachel Kim
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
Product & Ops
